description: List every student enrolled in a course (enrollment_type=student only), returning Canvas user objects (id, name, email, login_id) without grades or enrollment details. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. Use list_course_users for every role in the course (teachers, TAs, observers) or to filter users by enrollment_state, and list_course_enrollments when you need the enrollment/grade objects themselves (score, grade, enrollment workflow_state) rather than user profile fields. In pseudonymized mode every returned user's name and email are anonymized, since this endpoint carries no enrollment data for role classification to tell staff apart.
name: list_students
title: List Students
